name: What should I consider before planning a living room addition?

mainEntity.name: What should I consider before planning a living room addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before planning an addition, consider your budget, desired functionality for the new space, and how it will impact your existing home layout. Evaluate your property's setbacks and available space, as well as any neighborhood covenants. Gathering clear ideas about your needs and preferences, and having an understanding of your property's constraints, will help expedite the design and planning phases with your contractor.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider your budget, desired functionality, impact on layout, property setbacks, and neighborhood covenants. Understanding these helps streamline planning.
